description: A bearded man in a gold, battlemented crown and ornately embroidered robes draws a bow with an arrow nocked, standing in a chariot with a carved wooden side panel. Horses and their manes are visible at the lower right. Behind him, blurred soldiers with spears and a smoky dark sky fill a battlefield. Dark oil-painting style with no visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge. Some dark red on the robe, but no wounds or blood are visible.
